author: Thermetrics
versionDescription: Two fixes: (1) the PDF header (QUOTE #/CASE #/... and LOCATION OF ANNUAL CALIBRATION/...) used two independent side-by-side columns that drifted out of sync whenever a value wrapped (a long quote number, a full address) — rebuilt as one aligned 4-column table so rows stay in sync and long values wrap cleanly instead of overlapping or clipping past the page edge. (2) The Destination dropdown now lists countries alphabetically (A-Z) with 'In-house (no travel)' always pinned first, instead of whatever order Hailer's API happened to return them in.
